FIELDS.NAME: Sunnyvale Inn
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Sunnyvale Inn, we operate as a cozy bed and breakfast with a commitment to providing an inviting atmosphere for our guests. We proudly offer up to 10 well-appointed guest rooms, ensuring that our occupancy levels remain manageable, which allows us to deliver personalized service and maintain high cleanliness standards. Guests are provided with complimentary breakfast, featuring locally sourced ingredients, while adhering to rigorous food safety protocols. Our establishment is designed with guest safety in mind, equipped with functioning fire protection systems, and we consistently comply with local fire codes. Our operations are year-round, avoiding extended seasonal closures to ensure a stable ambiance and upkeep of the property. We also have a documented housekeeping schedule to maintain our facilities, with all maintenance regularly overseen to prevent any structural issues. With a welcoming environment and attention to detail, we strive to create memorable experiences for everyone who stays at Sunnyvale Inn.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not operate a Bed & Breakfast with more than 10 guest rooms and confirms that it does not have a motel with more than 20 guest rooms. Additionally, there are no on-site bar or lounge facilities, and meals are provided to guests at no additional charge.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2023, a water leak from an upper-floor bathroom caused damage to three guest rooms, resulting in repairs and cleaning costs totaling $2,000. The claim is currently resolved, and no further action is needed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, UL-rated, fire-resistant, with a Grade 1 lock, suitable for hotels and B&Bs.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with regular patrol by security personnel.
